name: Smart Post Scrollers
author: Reza Hossain Farukh

sections.description:
Smart Post Scrollers lets you display posts, products, RSS feeds, or custom XML content in a dynamic scrolling format. Perfect for news, updates, announcements, and live market tickers.

Watch How It Works:

Free Version Includes:
– Display blog posts by category
– Horizontal and vertical scroll
– RTL (Right-to-Left) support
– Marquee, Slide and Fade animations
– Basic controls

Premium Version Adds:
– Upload custom icons for each item
– Display WooCommerce products in the scroller
– Control fonts, colors, icons, speed, and layout
– Additional styling and animation customization

Ultimate Version Adds:
– Support for custom XML feeds
– Live stock market and exchange XML ticker support
– RSS feed

Whether you’re building a news ticker, product slider, or live financial feed — Smart Post Scrollers has you covered.

Support: https://orviansoft.com/get-support/

Use the form on that page to contact us. Choose the correct product type (WordPress Theme, WordPress Plugin, or React / NextJS Theme), complete the fields that appear, and attach a screenshot if it helps.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rzcps-post-scrollers folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode anywhere:
    [rzcps_post_scrollers id=”your_post_scroller_ID”]
sections.faq:
How do I get support?

Open our support page and use the form: https://orviansoft.com/get-support/

What should I include so you can help quickly?

  • Your website URL
  • Product type (WordPress Theme / WordPress Plugin / React / NextJS Theme) and the second dropdown when it appears (e.g. which plugin)
  • Order ID, if you have one
  • Scroller ID from WordPress admin: Post Scrollers — the shortcode looks like [rzcps_post_scrollers id="123"]; the number is the ID
  • A clear subject and description of the issue
  • Screenshots or a small export (the support form accepts common image types, PDF, or ZIP up to 10 MB)
